protocol.scope: supplemental actual-layout and real-pipeline growth/behavior probes; not a replacement adoption rule

layout.total_bytes: observed bytes_per_row * observed height; not an RSS estimate

source.pattern: horizontal RGB changing gradient, phase=index%640, plus 11-bit black/white frame-index strip; unique source images for indices 0...1199

units_evidence.getrusage_manual: selected SDK getrusage(2), lines 94-95: ru_maxrss is in bytes

measurement.scope: whole executable process, including startup, metadata validation/report emission; excludes fixture generation, compilation and subsequent VideoLab inspect
measurement.stdout: preserved as {id}.stdout.json for harness or {id}.stdout.log for lab
measurement.exit_code: record for every process, including failures

validation.metadata_output: {id}.metadata.json after measured process for lab; convert stdout already includes full metadata
validation.canvas: must equal observed layout mode width/height for identical render settings
validation.count_note: 116/576 are fixture predictions from existing ceil source-duration slots, not a new implementation; disagreement triggers investigation, never substitution
validation.resample_report: preserve all actual fields, require output count agrees with encoded count; do not assume all source frames are pulled
validation.source_identity: record generated source SHA256 once; same file reused for every row at that length

limits: One whole-process observation per row; descriptive, no new numerical adoption threshold.
Darwin time -l maximum resident set size is bytes per the retained host manuals; not Linux KiB.
